request.text: He got what he came for. We got two huts burned. Mind where you put your feet. The bog keeps what it gets.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a broad rural accent of the East Anglian fens. Female, 45-55. Excellent quality. Persona: a hard-faced swamp witch who lost her hut to fire and forgives nobody. Emotion: bitter, curt, hostile, contemptuous. A harsh, flat, gravelly voice, few words spat out short; a bog-dweller who has no patience left for strangers.
